from collections import Counter
import json
def transform(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0]); half=W//2; midc=W//2  # for odd W, center index
    cnt=Counter(c for r in g for c in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    divrows=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if len(set(r))==1 and r[0]!=bg]
    divcolor=g[divrows[0]][0]
    bounds=[-1]+divrows+[H]
    segs=[list(range(a+1,b)) for a,b in zip(bounds,bounds[1:]) if a+1<b]
    seg=max(segs,key=lambda s: sum(1 for i in s for c in g[i] if c!=bg))
    rows=[]
    for i in seg:
        r=g[i]; L=r[:half if W%2==0 else midc]
        L=r[:midc]; R=r[midc+1:]
        if all(c==bg for c in L) and any(c!=bg for c in R): src=R
        else: src=L
        row=src[:]+[divcolor]+src[:]
        rows.append(row)
    rows.append([divcolor]*W)
    return [rows[i%len(rows)] for i in range(H)]

def transform(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(c for r in g for c in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    divrows=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if len(set(r))==1 and r[0]!=bg]
    divcolor=g[divrows[0]][0]
    divcols=[j for j in range(W) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(H)})==1 and g[0][j]==divcolor]
    bounds=[-1]+divrows+[H]
    segs=[list(range(a+1,b)) for a,b in zip(bounds,bounds[1:]) if a+1<b]
    seg=max(segs,key=lambda s: len({tuple(g[i]) for i in s}))
    if divcols:
        fd=divcols[0]
        left=any(g[i][j]!=bg for i in seg for j in range(fd))
        rng=range(fd) if left else range(fd+1,W)
    else:
        rng=range(W)
    rows=[[g[i][j] for j in rng] for i in seg]
    unit=rows+[None]
    out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        u=unit[i%len(unit)]
        if u is None: out.append([divcolor]*W)
        else:
            r=u+[divcolor]
            r=(r*((W//len(r))+1))[:W]
            out.append(r)
    return out
